key.name: icon-size
key.description: Base size in pixels for dock icons (compact macOS style).

key.name: magnification-scale
key.description: Maximum zoom factor when hovering over an icon (1.1 to 2.0).

key.name: wave-radius
key.description: Distance in pixels around cursor for the wave effect to spread.

key.name: hide-overview-dash
key.description: Hide the native GNOME dash in overview so this dock takes its place.

key.name: autohide-in-fullscreen
key.description: Automatically hide the dock when a fullscreen or maximized window is active and reveal it when hovering over the dock area.

key.name: show-trash
key.description: Display the Trash bin icon at the end of the dock.

key.name: show-running
key.description: Show currently running applications in the dock even if not pinned.

key.name: show-apps-drawer
key.description: Show the Applications grid launcher button in the dock.

key.name: show-mounts
key.description: Show mounted disks, USB drives and removable devices in the dock.

key.name: dock-bottom-margin
key.description: Distance in pixels from the bottom edge of the screen.

key.name: dock-padding
key.description: Padding in pixels between icons and dock edges.

key.name: dock-border-radius
key.description: Corner curvature radius in pixels for the dock background.

key.name: dock-blur
key.description: Apply background blur effect behind the dock container.

key.name: dock-blur-radius
key.description: Radius for the background blur effect.

key.name: dock-opacity
key.description: Opacity percentage (0 to 100) of the dock background.

key.name: dock-border-opacity
key.description: Opacity percentage (0 to 100) of the dock border highlight.

key.name: dock-custom-color
key.description: Hex color code when dock-color is custom.
